_meta.description: Allowlist for the Command detection method, enforced by every path that may launch an executable named by a (potentially untrusted) applications catalog: the GUI detection probe, the post-update verification in the application-management service, and the PowerShell detection modules. allowedExecutables restricts WHICH programs may run; allowedArguments restricts WHAT they may be asked to do. Both are required: the executable list alone is not a boundary because it permits interpreters (python, node, pwsh, ruby, perl, php) that accept code as an argument, so 'pwsh -Command Start-Process calc' would otherwise run even though it contains no shell metacharacters. Detection only ever needs to ask a program for its version.
_meta.author: Julien Bombled
